F3 (E0): the operator induced by S_2(eta) is x^mu xi_mu. (normal-ordered field arrows) + eta^0. + Y, Y the constant antifield arrows lam* -> A* from integrating x^mu by parts (pairing preservation); [eta.,Q] = 0 holds with Y and fails with eta^0. alone as printed in Prop qs-comm (ii).

F4 (TQ0): along Sigma^* the closed quadratic directions of position degree <= 1 are x.(T1+T3) and x.(T2+T4) + s_0; s_0 is not an independent closed direction (Prop qs-freexi, last sentence, lists it as additional).

F5 (sign rule): in route B the defect cycles are D_x = +(hbar/2) sum s_x STr[...], s_x the Koszul factor of Def qs-defect (ii) WITHOUT its leading minus (special-edge parameter first, then for even x the CE coordinate). Fixed by G-pole on (A_perp, lam_+)|_{A_perp} (odd x, discriminating) and G-reg along P_b (even x). Same convention as composite engine B (Z_x = +(hbar/4) sum s(c,sigma) STr).

F6 (G-pole): for gauge-variant letters (general colour polarisations) the pole identity eq qs-pole needs the vacuum-pole x spectator terms: the cubic part of {S^(1)(xi),O} with the vacuum two-letter pole ct_1(A A) = 2(za.zb), and ct1_{xi,1}(sO) with the vacuum counterterm cycle ct1_xi(c, lam_+)|_0 = (1/2)(xi.zb) (the lam-c composite line closed on the pair); with them the identity holds exactly on the four gaugino pairs and on the pair of Example qs-cubic; they vanish only on colour singlets.

F7 (TQ3): Upsilon_xi(A_perp, lam_+) vanishes identically on the leg set lam_- lam_- at n = 0 (all letter, output and colour components, xi general): 16 nonzero configurations, each a rational multiple of log(4/3)/6, cancel. The beta gamma entry [BK (3.66)] is therefore not carried by the arity-one two-body kernel at n = 0 in this regularisation; the b c entry with b <-> (xi, lam*) (pair (c, lam*_+) -> lam_- lam_-) also vanishes. beta beta [BK (3.67)] is nonzero, antisymmetric in I, J, linear in the momenta.

F8 (closed form): a cycle with n_t edges whose Gaussian coefficient is a constant F (every leg set with superficial degree D = 0) gives 16 pi^2 [eps^0] = F log(n_t/(n_t-1))/(n_t-1)! and 16 pi^2 [eps^-1] = F/(n_t^2 (n_t-1)(n_t-1)!), verified exactly for n_t = 2..6.

F9 (TQ4): two-body part of Q_1 on the scalar bilinear O = int omega (iota_w1 A, iota_w2 A) (colour singlet, units u): -2 log(3/2) u {S^(1)(xi),O} on A_perp lam_+, plus the trace structures 4 log(3/2) u (w1.w2)(rho(Y_A) xi, Y_lam) on A_perp lam_+ and 4 log(3/2) u (w1.w2) Gamma(xi,Y_lam)|_V . Y_AV on A_V lam_-; the leg sets lam_- and c lam*_+ vanish on the singlet; no poles.
